mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand for housing and durable goods, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate revenue growth and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% combined with strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150k) indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 5.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 (index 2017=100) combined with rising input costs (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY) indicates a supply-side shock, which reduces corporate margins and increases uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 102.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered instances.
